subject.title: fix(repair): let the model choose cluster work

question: Should scheduled cluster intake replace the deterministic selector with model judgment now, and what upgrade contract must existing `CLAWSWEEPER_CLUSTER_REPAIR_IMPORT_LIMIT` users receive?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the selection policy and removes a documented configuration surface; deciding whether compatibility is preserved, migrated, or deliberately broken is a maintainer product and operational policy choice.

options.title: Preserve the existing configuration contract
options.body: Retain the old import-limit behavior or a tested compatibility path while introducing model selection behind an explicit, documented transition.

options.title: Approve a deliberate breaking transition
options.body: Accept the new one-cluster model selector and publish an explicit versioned migration path that tells operators how their existing setting changes.

options.title: Keep deterministic intake for now
options.body: Defer the model-owned selection boundary until maintainers want to run and own controlled production proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing configuration contract
recommendation.body: Retain the old import-limit behavior or a tested compatibility path while introducing model selection behind an explicit, documented transition.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged selector foundation and authored this replacement, including the configuration compatibility changes.
